issues.detail: The Greek 'εἰ δε ποιω καν εμοι' (if I do anything for me/myself) is rendered as 'nếu ta làm' (if I do), omitting the reflexive/self-serving aspect of 'εμοι'. The Vietnamese translation fails to convey that the condition is doing something for one's own sake.
The Greek 'καν' (anything) is omitted in the Vietnamese translation, which softens the scope of the conditional statement.
